reason: Each per-group queue is created as `queue.Queue()` with no maxsize (src/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/queue_consumer.py:185) and `FixedQueuePool.submit` does a `work_queue.put(work_item)` that can never block or fail (queue_consumer.py:212). `MessageRejected` appears nowhere in the file and the strategy's `submit` never raises it, so the 'Natural backpressure when queues fill up' docstring (queue_consumer.py:253) is false and queued items grow without limit when workers are slower than Kafka intake.
